source_roles.Pi: The source model's 3 independent motor-joint dimensions q1–3 and 2D Cartesian target/outcome distinction, training/test identities; no source evidence human explicit discrete internal skill units from those partitions.
source_roles.X: Actual original synthetic model learned inverse local-linear mapping g:(x,y)→q plus history-dependent values at training step t; source human internal representation not directly measured, all source PCA is external analysis.
source_roles.C: Original source model's realizability task 3 joint→2 endpoint motor redundancy and bounded exploration noise/rate constraints; experimental sample condition H1/H2 stays L_ctx rather than C merely called a condition.
source_roles.Q: Goal-relative model feedback/orientation to externally given x* and original source choice among interpolated subtargets; do not invent internally autonomously discovered new goal value criterion or human brain intrinsic goal setter.
source_roles.P_in: Externally generated selected task target x*, original simulator's actual outcome feedback f(q) presented at accessible model-system boundary. Human displayed goal is a distinct experimental input.
source_roles.P_out: Original synthetic agent produced joint motor command q from local linear inverse output qhat(x*) + slow exploratory e, actual observed endpoint f(q) after physical execution is an output/feedback observation; human measured movement separate.
source_roles.K: Actual source model on-line local-linear inverse correction g informed by goal-related observed execution (fixed η=.2), source-defined subtarget interpolation and bounded explorative q generation. No independent learned forward predictor, invented multilevel supervisor or adaptive-rate law.
source_roles.T: Original subgoal interpolation steps (24 intermediate, 25 motor updates/target), training targets 40/block and trial/block progression (1000 updates/block), retained inverse g and time-varying exploratory noise.
source_roles.rho/O: Original observed human 3-joint/2D action and experimenter-derived statistical traces, including original MAIN PDF human Condition p=.944 versus same PLOS-issued original s006 S1 Table Condition printed p=.44. These disagree despite same F=.01; both null. This inconsistency is retained in L_claim source assertion, not reified as a model-internal observable or declared corrected.

System_World_Experiment.System: Hypothetical artificial agent source defined motor inverse local-linear map g, fixed learning rate η=.2, simple source-defined subtarget interpolation and exploration in motor q. Human motor learning is an experimentally observed system but internal model identity not uniquely identified.
System_World_Experiment.World: Original forward task f(q): 3-joint posture to 2D arm endpoint, externally defined 16 training goals, two start postures with same endpoint, exogenous chosen goals x*, simulation task distances. No invented system-learned f.
System_World_Experiment.Experiment: Experimenter runs 20 human participants 24×80s blocks and model 100 agents in two fixed source conditions, supplies targets and feedback, computes PCA/statistics from observed behavior, compares actual different strategies, has 4 supplementary tables of source-specific tests.
System_World_Experiment.boundary_rule: Human EEG/neural source not measured. The original optimizer fits artificial inverse model via known target/outcome feedback, while author PCA and between-condition p-values are experimenter observations, not human internal Q/K.
